lines.text: Many learners say: We stayed home because of it was cold.
Better: We stayed home because it was cold.
Use because with a full sentence.
Because! I stay home because it is cold.

native.tip: Ardından özne ve fiil geliyorsa “because”, yalnızca bir isim geliyorsa “because of” kullanılır: “We stayed home because it was cold.”
native.caption: “We stayed home because of it was cold” mi diyorsun? 😅 Ardından tam bir cümle geliyorsa “because of” değil, “because” kullanılır. Doğrusu “We stayed home because it was cold.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “because”. Arkasından cümle geliyorsa “because” kullan. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: Use “because” before a subject and a verb: “We stayed home because it was cold.”
en.caption: Do you say “We stayed home because of it was cold”? 😅 In English before a full sentence we say because, not because of. The right sentence is “We stayed home because it was cold.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
